description: This file defines the Draggable class for making DOM elements draggable with touch and mouse support, used internally in the Leaflet mapping library.

classes.name: Draggable
classes.description: A class for making DOM elements draggable, supporting touch and mouse events, used internally in Leaflet for map and marker dragging.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Draggable object for moving an element with optional drag handle and outline prevention.

methods.name: _onDown
methods.description: Handles the initial mouse/touch down event to start dragging.

methods.name: _onMove
methods.description: Handles the move event during dragging, updating position.

methods.name: _updatePosition
methods.description: Updates the element's position during dragging.

methods.name: _onUp
methods.description: Handles the mouse/touch up event to end dragging.

methods.name: finishDrag
methods.description: Finalizes the drag operation, cleans up event listeners and classes.
